# Arcan Painting

> Arcan Painting is Toronto's trusted family-owned painting contractor, proudly serving the Greater Toronto Area since 1995. Founded by Jose Cañabate in Argentina, the business was brought to Toronto where it has grown across three generations of the Cañabate family.

## Services
- Interior painting (residential and commercial)
- Exterior painting (weather-resistant for Ontario's climate)
- Commercial painting (offices, retail, facilities)
- Wallpaper installation and removal
- Specialty finishes (faux textures, Venetian plaster, limewash)
- Colour consultation

## Service Area
Greater Toronto Area: Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby

## Key Facts
- Family-owned since 1995 (3 generations)
- Licensed, insured, and bonded
- 2-year warranty on interior work
- 5-year warranty on exterior work
- No subcontractors — all work done by the Cañabate family
- Free estimates within 24 hours
- Uses Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore premium paints
